long_biography.plain_text:
Luciano Gandini worked in packaging automation in North Carolina before returning to his native Piacenza. Looking for a way to carry six bottles together, he developed a handle strip and machines to apply it to beverage packs. Twin Pack expanded that technical idea across food, dairy and tissue products, then developed broader systems for secondary packaging. Gandini remained its chief executive and controlling owner when Consilium acquired a minority interest in 2026, financing an international growth effort rather than buying him out.

His other sustained industrial interest is the Mylius boatyard. He brought the sailboat builder to the Piacenza area and serves as its president, while his daughter Valentina runs it as chief executive. The company designs and constructs performance sailing craft, and he remains closely involved in competitive racing. The boatbuilding activity reflects his sailing interests and business experience, but Twin Pack's packaging machinery remains the best-documented basis for his business wealth. No public deal price establishes the value of his retained stake.
